ch.title: 更新说明
content: 修复后台恢复时的 WebView 卡死，底部四个栏目保持可点。
兼容 0.1.6 及更早的原生壳，避免升级后停在启动页。
新增 Android 推送通知与通知点击跳转支持。

en.title: Release Notes
content: Fixes the WebView freeze after foreground recovery; all four bottom tabs stay responsive.
Keeps older 0.1.6 native shells booting instead of freezing on the launch splash.
Adds Android push notifications and notification tap routing.
